Oleksandr (Alex) Vysotsky
I am Oleksandr (Alex) Vysotsky - a systematic trader with 20+ years in algorithmic trading and 6+ years of experience in crypto derivatives on Deribit (now part of Coinbase). In 2024–2025, I developed VAN - a proprietary trading system built with an emphasis on robust logic, disciplined risk control, and investor-oriented operation. Since November 14, 2025, I have been running a live reference account with fully public, real-time performance tracking of latest VAN system modification - VAN_Combo_1. Live performance is publicly available 24/7 here. The strategy is fully systematic, designed for investor-account environments, and focused on crypto futures and options on Deribit. If you are an investor, allocator, or introducer interested in systematic trading and performance-aligned capital partnerships - feel free to contact me here.
